title: Gate-3 adversarial bug-hunt report (.methodology/bug_hunt_report.json)
description: Canonicalized from the tts-new hunt workflow (FINDING/VERIFY schemas) plus the resolution contract. Consumed by core/quality_gate/bug_hunt_verifier.py: the adversarial_review gate dimension scores 100 only when every CONFIRMED critical/high finding is resolved (with fix_commit or repro_test evidence) or refuted (with refute_evidence). Producing agent: harness/ssi/prompts/hunt_bugs.md. Do NOT write a .sessi-work score file for adversarial_review — the framework computes the dimension from this report (traceability pattern).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the hunt run

git_sha.description: HEAD at scan time; verifier warns (not blocks) when it drifts

confirmed.description: adversarial verify outcome (refute+confirm verifiers); only confirmed findings can block

verify_evidence.description: line citation from the confirming verifier

repro_test.description: project-relative test path reproducing the bug (resolved; must exist — anti-fabrication)
